name: m4_no_invented_memory
spec: SPEC §16.2 M4: asked about a trip that was never mentioned, the agent says it doesn't recall rather than inventing one. Bar (§3.3): zero invented memories; run with --repeat 10 for the 10-call version.

turns.say: Did I tell you about my trip?

speechExcludes: your trip (to|was|went)|(hope|glad) you enjoyed your trip|how was (the|your) trip to

turns.say: Oh, maybe I didn't. Never mind. Goodbye.
